# Cursor BYOK v1.0.3

## 更新内容

- 拆分供应商与模型配置，支持复用供应商配置；模型列表按供应商分组，支持拖拽调整供应商和模型顺序。
- 修正模型测速与调用统计的速度计算，细化首字延迟、生成速度和端到端耗时展示，完善批量模型测试。
- 概览的周、月范围按自然周和自然月对齐，记住时间范围选择；自定义时间范围改用月历选择器。
- 活动日历新增柱状图和折线图视图，支持切换统计指标并记住显示偏好。
- 补充服务端回归测试、前端单元测试和浏览器冒烟测试，完善发布前检查。

## Changes

- Separate provider and model configuration so models can share provider settings; group models by provider and support drag reordering of providers and models.
- Improve model speed measurement and call statistics, clarify first-token latency, generation speed and end-to-end timing, and refine batch model testing.
- Align overview week and month ranges to calendar boundaries, persist range selections, and use a month calendar for custom date ranges.
- Add bar and line views to the activity calendar, with selectable metrics and persistent display preferences.
- Expand server regression tests, frontend unit tests and browser smoke tests, and strengthen release checks.

## 注意事项 / Notes

- 本分支当前仅构建与测试 Windows x64（NSIS 安装包与便携版 ZIP）。This fork currently targets and tests Windows x64 only (NSIS installer and portable ZIP).
- 安装包仅包含应用内更新签名，未做 Windows Authenticode 代码签名。The installer uses Tauri updater signatures only and is not Authenticode-signed.
